characters.notes: The capcom_only and draft_only entries are one move (SA1 Bushin Beats) whose invulnerable window ends on frame 14 in Capcom and frame 12 in SuperCombo. Neither roster_text file has a jump row. Kimberly has no meterless or Overdrive move that either source calls strike-invulnerable from frame 1; the draft's reversal list (SA1, SA1 hold, SA3, CA) is complete for that class apart from the SA2 frame-1 question above. Sprint follow-ups (OD Shadow Slide low profile from frame 4, Shadow Slide from frame 6) need Sprint first, Water Slicer Slide's low profile starts on frame 9 (SuperCombo line 19), and Standing Heavy Kick's upper-body air invulnerability starts on frame 10 (SuperCombo line 6); all excluded as too late or needing a previous move.
